title: Mirror a binary tree
summary: Swap every gardener's left and right flower beds, then ask their children to do the same; the whole garden ends up mirrored.
goal: Mirror the garden left to right

mapping.formal: A node's left and right children

mapping.story: Asking children to do the same

ladder.name: Rebuild floor by floor
ladder.idea: Write every floor of the garden as a list including gaps, reverse each list, and build a new garden from them.

ladder.name: Swap, then let the children swap
ladder.idea: At each node, swap its left and right children, then mirror each child the same way.
ladder.insight: Mirroring a tree is the same as swapping the two children and mirroring each of them: a smaller version of the same task, which recursion handles in place.

transfer.problem: Check whether a tree is a mirror of itself (symmetric).
transfer.explanation: Compare the left subtree with the mirror of the right one, recursively: same shape of recursion on two children.

selfCheck: Swaps the children at every node.
